verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents adding SAFEs directly to the cap table (eqvista-docs-10) and built-in e-signing (eqvista-docs-11). Its Premium plan explicitly lists "E-signing certificates & SAFE agreements" (eqvista-supp-cert-esign-pricing). A support article on converting notes using the price-per-share method (eqvista-docs-18) and round modeling of dilution from new investments (eqvista-docs-19, eqvista-docs-20) point to conversion handling. missing for 10: documented SAFE/note document creation and send-to-investor workflow, explicit modeling of SAFE/note conversion terms (caps, discounts) on the cap table, convertible-note e-signing evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration; e-signing is Premium-only.
